data.name: lichtung
data.detailed_description:
lichtung is a 12-minute VR experience about light, perception, and quiet discovery.

You find yourself in a dark forest only equipped with a flashlight in your hand. What you choose to illuminate slowly comes to life: drifting pollen, floating mushroom creatures, subtle movements in the trees. The forest reveals itself through your curiosity.

The world combines hand-drawn 2D animated creatures with a spatial 3D forest environment. The black-and-white forest gradually transforms as you explore. An evolving spatial soundscape accompanies your journey, growing richer as the world awakens around you.

Features

  • Approximately 12-minute atmospheric VR experience

  • Intuitive one-button interaction: No tutorials or text

  • Hand-drawn 2D animated creatures embedded in a 3D forest

  • Distinct black-and-white visual style focused on light and shadow

  • Evolving spatial sound design that responds to your exploration

  • Accessible for players of all ages and VR experience levels

A Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg production

Game Director: Aria Wolf

Assistant Director & Level Design: Janina Zlotos

Game Designer & Programmer: Sam Matsa

Technical Director: Jakob Bock

Producer: Cyril Fischer & Christoph Mohr

Art Director: Maksym Gontov

Animation: Vadim Ivanov & Maksym Gontov

Additional Animation: Sofi Shapir & Nike Weber

Audio Direction: Tristan Steinmetz

Music: Clemens David Krauß & Constantin Rinke (Samples unterm Sofa)

Sound Design: Tristan Steinmetz & Armin Biemel & Dominic Häberer

Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg, home to the Animationsinstitut and the postgraduate programme Atelier Ludwigsburg-Paris, is one of the world's leading film and media universities. On its unique campus, which also houses the neighbouring Academy of Performing Arts, its approximately 500 students receive a broad, interdisciplinary, practice-oriented and industry-relevant education from over 300 experts from the film and media industries. Programmes range from film and animation to interactive media, including games, installations and digital experiences.

© Filmakademie Baden-Württemberg GmbH 2026

data.short_description: Enter a calm and unfamiliar world, lying dormant as you arrive. As you explore its surroundings, the world gradually opens up, revealing its light. The more you engage with it, the more you become enveloped in a soothing yet lively awakening, full of surprises.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (version 1909 or higher)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC
